apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.4.5 — Song detail waveform touches fixed by touch forwarding: the pinned-scroll ScrollView still fronts the page, but a transparent top layer now hands touches in the wave strip to the waveform while the page rests at the top — Follow, Fit, the armed-loop badge, tap-seek and pinch all work. Scrolling, content sliding over the wave, and the pinned playback header are unchanged.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
